paragraphs.source_en: well. We can phase out products that no longer carry their own weight, and we can often reduce the investments in our cash-cow products so that we can invest more in future sources of revenue and growth. There are any number of ways to think about spreading out your investments over time and risk. Some people like the three horizons model, while others take more of a portfolio management approach. The point here is that you need to have an investment strategy, and your team structure should be a reflection of that.
